symptom: `use building block PlatformDesignSystem.Button (action: call microflow M.F) as b_` fails exec with `action override supplied, but the block has no button to rebind`; the block is one pluggable `pdsbutton pDSButton1`. Same for any block whose only clickable widget is pluggable (Atlas Card_WithImage's Image)
cause: The ActionOverride target predicate isButtonWidget matched the core keywords actionbutton/linkbutton/button only; a pluggable widget's action lives in a definition-declared property
insight: Ask the widget definition, not a name list: GenerateDefJSON gives every click action (onClick, onClickAction, onClickEvent) Source "OnClick" via actionSourceForKey, and the engine reads that Source from Properties["Action"] — so the override's write is unchanged, only the predicate widens. "Has an action property" alone is too wide: the pluggable Gallery and Data Grid 2 have onClick (an item action) and combobox/slider have onChange, so require Source OnClick and no datasource mapping. Try core buttons over the whole block FIRST and fall back to pluggable ones, or Atlas Card_ActionWithImage (image, then button) would silently move its override onto the image. Mock trap: a propertyless pluggable widget describes as the LAST SEGMENT of its widget id (extractCustomWidgetType), so a test id ending `.Button` renders as the core `button` keyword — use the real-shaped `…PDSButton`. PlatformDesignSystem is not fetchable here (no marketplace PAT, not in the cached catalog); measured instead on 11.14.0 with Card_WithImage: before, the same refusal; after, the Image gets OnClick and mx check reports 0 errors. Tests `use_building_block_pluggable_action_2145_test.go`; control = pre-fix run, the two pluggable tests failed with the reported message
